fsm_states.name: IDLE
fsm_states.description: CS# high; bus idle, controller waiting to issue a command.

fsm_states.name: SELECT
fsm_states.description: Controller drives CS# low to begin a command.

fsm_states.name: INSTRUCTION
fsm_states.description: 8-bit opcode shifted out (16-bit with command extension in xSPI octal mode), MSB-first, on 1/4/8 lanes.

fsm_states.name: ADDRESS
fsm_states.description: 3 or 4 address bytes shifted out on the address lanes (for commands that take an address).

fsm_states.name: MODE_BITS
fsm_states.description: Optional mode/alternate bits for continuous-read / XIP.

fsm_states.name: DUMMY
fsm_states.description: Programmable dummy cycles with no data driven, absorbing the device read latency.

fsm_states.name: DATA
fsm_states.description: Data byte(s) read or written on the data lanes, MSB-first; DDR uses both SCLK edges, octal DDR aligns to DQS.

fsm_states.name: DESELECT
fsm_states.description: CS# high ends the command; bus returns to IDLE.

fsm_states.name: PROGRAM_ERASE
fsm_states.description: After WREN (sets WEL) the device performs Page Program / Erase; WIP=1 while busy.

fsm_states.name: POLL_WIP
fsm_states.description: Controller issues Read Status (0x05) repeatedly until WIP clears, signaling completion.

fsm_hints.trigger: CS# falling begins a command; the opcode selects the phase sequence (which of address/mode/dummy/data phases are present and on how many lanes).
fsm_hints.rule: Dummy cycles MUST match the configured/SFDP-declared latency for the read mode and frequency, or the data phase is misaligned.
fsm_hints.program_erase: WEL must be set (0x06) before program/erase; the controller polls WIP via 0x05 for completion.

anti_deadlock_rule: Master always drives SCK; slave never drives SCK. There is no combinational dependency between master and slave control paths.
exit_from_reset: After reset, SPI is disabled (SPE=0). Software must set SPE=1 (and other bits as desired) to begin operation.

default_ready_state_recommendation.SS_master_output: HIGH between transfers (deselect slave); LOW for the duration of one byte when SSOE+MODFEN active.
default_ready_state_recommendation.SS_slave_input: Must remain LOW for the full 8-bit transfer; going HIGH mid-transfer aborts and forces idle.
default_ready_state_recommendation.MISO_slave_output: High-impedance when SS is HIGH (slave deselected); driven only while SS LOW.

channel_dependency_rules_master.note: Master drives SCK and SS; samples MISO on (CPHA-selected edge); shifts MOSI on opposite edge.

channel_dependency_rules_slave.note: Slave samples MOSI on master-defined (CPHA-selected) edge; shifts MISO on opposite edge. Requires SS LOW.

mode_fault_detection: If SS input goes LOW while configured as Master with MODFEN=1, MODF flag is set, MSTR is cleared (slave mode), and outputs go high-Z. Any in-progress transmission is aborted.
dummy_cycle_logic: The dummy-cycle count between the address/mode phase and the data phase is configurable (and SFDP-discoverable). It absorbs the device's internal read access latency; too few dummy cycles at high SCLK frequency corrupts the read.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on/RESET#/software reset (0x66 then 0x99) the device powers up in single-IO (1-1-1) SPI mode with default (often 3-byte) addressing; the controller may read SFDP, then switch protocol mode (QPI / octal) and address-byte count via configuration commands.

configurations.name: Octal SDR (8-8-8)
configurations.description: x8 data path, single data rate.

configurations.name: Octal DDR (8D-8D-8D)
configurations.description: x8 double data rate with DQS source-synchronous capture (xSPI).

configurations.name: Continuous Read / XIP
configurations.description: Mode bits keep the device in read so the next access skips the instruction phase.
